verdict.rationale: Airweave syncs and indexes user data, so a training opt-out or no-training data policy is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack contains no statement, setting or policy about whether ingested data is used to train AI models. Local self-hosting is documented, but it is an adjacent deployment option, not a documented training-prevention control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
